question: What are the top 5 most frequently purchased products in our bakery?
gold_query: SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, COUNT(*) AS PurchaseCount FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor ORDER BY PurchaseCount DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_query: WITH PurchasesCTE AS (SELECT i.Item, COUNT(*) AS PurchaseCount FROM items i GROUP BY i.Item) SELECT g.Id, g.Flavor, g.Food, p.PurchaseCount FROM PurchasesCTE p JOIN goods g ON p.Item = g.Id ORDER BY p.PurchaseCount DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which customers spent the most in total at our bakery during October 2007?
gold_query: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query:
WITH CustomerTotals AS (
  SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent
  FROM customers c
  JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId
  JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 7) AS TEXT) = '2007-10'
  GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName
)
SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, TotalSpent
FROM CustomerTotals
ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average transaction value for each day of the week?
gold_query: SELECT CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS DayOfWeek, AVG(subquery.ReceiptTotal) AS AverageTransactionValue FROM receipts r JOIN (SELECT i.Receipt, SUM(g.Price) AS ReceiptTotal FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY i.Receipt) subquery ON r.ReceiptNumber = subquery.Receipt GROUP BY DayOfWeek ORDER BY CASE DayOfWeek WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END;
generated_query: WITH ReceiptTotals AS (SELECT i.Receipt, SUM(g.Price) AS Total FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY i.Receipt) SELECT CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS DayOfWeek, AVG(rt.Total) AS AverageTransactionValue FROM receipts r JOIN ReceiptTotals rt ON r.ReceiptNumber = rt.Receipt GROUP BY CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END ORDER BY CASE DayOfWeek WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3 WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END;

question: What are the three most popular product categories based on total sales?
gold_query: SELECT g.Food AS Category, COUNT(*) AS TotalSales FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Food ORDER BY TotalSales DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_query:
WITH RevenueByFood AS (
  SELECT g.Food, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue
  FROM items i
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  GROUP BY g.Food
)
SELECT Food, TotalRevenue
FROM RevenueByFood
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 3;

question: Which products generated the most revenue in October 2007?
gold_query: SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query:
WITH RevenueCTE AS (
  SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue
  FROM items i
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  JOIN receipts r ON i.Receipt = r.ReceiptNumber
  WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 7) AS TEXT) = '2007-10'
  GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor
)
SELECT RevenueCTE.Id, RevenueCTE.Food, RevenueCTE.Flavor, RevenueCTE.TotalRevenue
FROM RevenueCTE
ORDER BY RevenueCTE.TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: Who are our top 10 customers by number of visits?
gold_query: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS NumberOfVisits FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY NumberOfVisits DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query: WITH CustomerVisits AS (SELECT c.Id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS NumberOfVisits FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Id) SELECT cv.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, cv.NumberOfVisits FROM CustomerVisits cv JOIN customers c ON cv.Id = c.Id ORDER BY cv.NumberOfVisits DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the daily revenue trend throughout October 2007?
gold_query: SELECT SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, LENGTH(r.Date) - 2) AS SaleDate, SUM(g.Price) AS DailyRevenue FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY SaleDate ORDER BY SaleDate;
generated_query:
WITH DailyRevenue AS (
  SELECT SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS Day, SUM(g.Price) AS DailyRevenue
  FROM receipts r
  JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  WHERE SUBSTR(r.Date, 5, 2) = '10' AND SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 4) = '2007'
  GROUP BY SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2)
)
SELECT *
FROM DailyRevenue
ORDER BY Day;

question: Which product flavors appear across multiple product categories?
gold_query: SELECT g.Flavor, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS CategoryCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS Categories FROM goods g GROUP BY g.Flavor HAVING CategoryCount > 1 ORDER BY CategoryCount DESC;
generated_query:
WITH FlavorsPerCategory AS (
  SELECT g.Food, g.Flavor
  FROM items i
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  GROUP BY g.Food, g.Flavor
)
SELECT Flavor
FROM FlavorsPerCategory
GROUP BY Flavor
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Food) > 1;

question: What is the average number of items purchased per transaction?
gold_query: SELECT AVG(ItemCount) AS AverageItemsPerTransaction FROM (SELECT i.Receipt, COUNT(*) AS ItemCount FROM items i GROUP BY i.Receipt);
generated_query: WITH TransactionTotals AS (SELECT i.Receipt, COUNT(*) AS ItemCount FROM items i GROUP BY i.Receipt) SELECT AVG(tt.ItemCount) AS AverageItemsPerTransaction FROM TransactionTotals tt;

question: Which products are most commonly purchased together?
gold_query: SELECT g1.Food || ' - ' || g1.Flavor AS Product1, g2.Food || ' - ' || g2.Flavor AS Product2, COUNT(*) AS PairCount FROM items i1 JOIN items i2 ON i1.Receipt = i2.Receipt AND i1.Item < i2.Item JOIN goods g1 ON i1.Item = g1.Id JOIN goods g2 ON i2.Item = g2.Id GROUP BY Product1, Product2 ORDER BY PairCount DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query:
WITH ProductPairs AS (
  SELECT i1.Item AS Product1, i2.Item AS Product2
  FROM items i1
  JOIN items i2 ON i1.Receipt = i2.Receipt AND i1.Ordinal < i2.Ordinal
)
SELECT g1.Food ||'-'|| g1.Flavor AS Product1, g2.Food ||'-'|| g2.Flavor AS Product2, COUNT(*) AS PairCount
FROM ProductPairs pp
JOIN goods g1 ON pp.Product1 = g1.Id
JOIN goods g2 ON pp.Product2 = g2.Id
GROUP BY Product1, Product2
ORDER BY PairCount DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: What day of the week has the highest number of transactions?
gold_query: SELECT CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' ELSE 'Sunday' END AS DayOfWeek, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS TransactionCount FROM receipts r GROUP BY DayOfWeek ORDER BY TransactionCount DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_query:
WITH DayOfWeekCTE AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday' END AS DayOfWeek,
    COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS TransactionCount
  FROM receipts r
  GROUP BY CASE CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 WHEN 1 THEN 'Monday' WHEN 2 THEN 'Tuesday' WHEN 3 THEN 'Wednesday' WHEN 4 THEN 'Thursday' WHEN 5 THEN 'Friday' WHEN 6 THEN 'Saturday' WHEN 0 THEN 'Sunday' END
)
SELECT DayOfWeekCTE.DayOfWeek, DayOfWeekCTE.TransactionCount
FROM DayOfWeekCTE
ORDER BY DayOfWeekCTE.TransactionCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which customers have purchased at least one item from each product category?
gold_query: WITH CustomerCategories AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.CustomerId, g.Food AS Category FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id), CategoryCount AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Food) AS TotalCategories FROM goods) SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName || ' ' || c.LastName AS CustomerName, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.Category) AS CategoriesPurchased FROM customers c JOIN CustomerCategories cc ON c.Id = cc.CustomerId CROSS JOIN CategoryCount cat GROUP BY c.Id, CustomerName HAVING CategoriesPurchased = cat.TotalCategories ORDER BY c.Id;
generated_query:
WITH CustomerCategories AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, g.Food AS Category
  FROM customers c
  JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId
  JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
)
SELECT *
FROM CustomerCategories
GROUP BY Id, FirstName, LastName
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT Category) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Food) FROM goods)

question: What is the revenue distribution by product category?
gold_query: SELECT g.Food AS Category, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue, ROUND(SUM(g.Price) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(Price) FROM goods JOIN items ON goods.Id = items.Item), 2) AS PercentOfTotalRevenue FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Food ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;
generated_query: WITH RevenueByFood AS (SELECT g.Food, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Food) SELECT Food, TotalRevenue, ROUND(TotalRevenue * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(g.Price) FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id), 2) AS PercentOfTotalRevenue FROM RevenueByFood ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

question: Which customers made multiple visits to our bakery in October 2007?
gold_query: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS VisitCount FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING VisitCount > 1 ORDER BY VisitCount DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query: WITH CustomerCTE AS (SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS VisitCount FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId WHERE SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 7) = '2007-10' GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING VisitCount > 1) SELECT CustomerCTE.Id, CustomerCTE.FirstName, CustomerCTE.LastName, (SELECT COUNT(r.ReceiptNumber) FROM receipts r WHERE r.CustomerId = CustomerCTE.Id AND SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 7) = '2007-10') AS OctoberVisitCount FROM CustomerCTE ORDER BY OctoberVisitCount DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which products have the highest price to sales ratio?
gold_query: SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, g.Price, COUNT(*) AS SalesCount, ROUND(g.Price / COUNT(*), 2) AS PriceToSalesRatio FROM items i JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, g.Price ORDER BY PriceToSalesRatio DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query:
WITH ProductRatios AS (
  SELECT g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, g.Price, COUNT(*) AS SalesCount, ROUND(g.Price / COUNT(*), 2) AS PriceToSalesRatio
  FROM items i
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
  GROUP BY g.Id, g.Food, g.Flavor, g.Price
)
SELECT *
FROM ProductRatios
ORDER BY PriceToSalesRatio DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average spending per visit for each customer?
gold_query: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS VisitCount, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent, ROUND(SUM(g.Price) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber), 2) AS AverageSpendPerVisit FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY AverageSpendPerVisit DESC;
generated_query: WITH CustomerReceipts AS (SELECT c.Id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS VisitCount, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalSpent FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id) SELECT cr.Id, cr.VisitCount, cr.TotalSpent, ROUND(cr.TotalSpent / cr.VisitCount, 2) AS AverageSpendPerVisit FROM CustomerReceipts cr ORDER BY cr.AverageSpendPerVisit DESC;

question: How do weekday sales compare to weekend sales in terms of volume and revenue?
gold_query: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend' ELSE 'Weekday' END AS DayType, COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber) AS TransactionCount, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(*) AS ItemsSold, ROUND(SUM(g.Price) / COUNT(DISTINCT r.ReceiptNumber), 2) AS AverageTransactionValue FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY DayType;
generated_query:
WITH DayTypeCTE AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) % 7 IN (0, 6) THEN 'Weekend'
         ELSE 'Weekday' END AS DayType,
    r.ReceiptNumber,
    g.Price
  FROM receipts r
  JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt
  JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id
)
SELECT 
  DayTypeCTE.DayType,
  COUNT(DISTINCT DayTypeCTE.ReceiptNumber) AS TransactionCount,
  SUM(DayTypeCTE.Price) AS TotalRevenue,
  COUNT(*) AS ItemsSold,
  ROUND(SUM(DayTypeCTE.Price) / COUNT(DISTINCT DayTypeCTE.ReceiptNumber), 2) AS AverageTransactionValue
FROM DayTypeCTE
GROUP BY DayTypeCTE.DayType;

question: What time of the month (early, mid, late) has the highest sales?
gold_query: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 10 THEN 'Early October' WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(r.Date, 2, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 20 THEN 'Mid October' ELSE 'Late October' END AS TimePeriod, COUNT(*) AS ItemsSold, SUM(g.Price) AS TotalRevenue FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY TimePeriod ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;
generated_query:
WITH ReceiptTotals AS (SELECT r.Date, SUM(g.Price) AS Total FROM receipts r JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY r.Date) 
SELECT 
  CASE WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(rt.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 10 THEN 'Early' 
       WHEN CAST(SUBSTR(rt.Date, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) <= 20 THEN 'Mid' 
       ELSE 'Late' END AS TimePeriod, 
  SUM(rt.Total) AS TotalRevenue 
FROM ReceiptTotals rt 
GROUP BY TimePeriod 
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC 
LIMIT 1

question: Which customers purchase the most varied products?
gold_query: SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Id) AS UniqueProducts, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS UniqueCategories, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Flavor) AS UniqueFlavors FROM customers c JOIN receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY UniqueProducts DESC, UniqueCategories DESC, UniqueFlavors DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_query: WITH CustomerProducts AS ( SELECT c.Id, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Id) AS UniqueProducts, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Food) AS UniqueCategories, COUNT(DISTINCT g.Flavor) AS UniqueFlavors FROM Customers c JOIN Receipts r ON c.Id = r.CustomerId JOIN Items i ON r.ReceiptNumber = i.Receipt JOIN Goods g ON i.Item = g.Id GROUP BY c.Id ) SELECT c.Id, c.FirstName, c.LastName, cp.UniqueProducts, cp.UniqueCategories, cp.UniqueFlavors FROM CustomerProducts cp JOIN Customers c ON cp.Id = c.Id ORDER BY cp.UniqueProducts + cp.UniqueCategories + cp.UniqueFlavors DESC LIMIT 10;
